settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Company identity, invoicing, operations, integrations and alerts of Helio.
settings.saveFailed: The settings could not be saved

sections.identity_description: How Helio appears on quotes, invoices and the customer portal.
sections.branding_description: The colour and tagline of the documents, the logo and the company's files.
sections.invoicing_description: Payment terms, VAT and how invoices and quotes are numbered.
sections.collections_description: Late fees and the reminders sent for unpaid invoices.
sections.hours_description: When crews work and how fast tickets must be handled.
sections.fieldwork_description: Who is assigned by default and where Helio installs.
sections.api_description: Access for the monitoring platform, the ERP and team chat. The demo keeps these settings without calling the services.
sections.email_description: The server for quotes, invoices and reminders. The demo sends its e-mails through the mailing module instead.
sections.accounting_description: The software issued and paid invoices are exported to. The demo keeps the choice without exporting.

fields.notifyOfflineSites_label: Alert when an installation goes offline
fields.notifyOverdueInvoices_label: Alert when an invoice becomes overdue

descriptions.address: Printed on every quote and invoice.
descriptions.logo: PNG, SVG or WebP, kept in the media library for the team to reuse.
descriptions.tagline: One line under the company name on quotes, in each language Helio writes in.
descriptions.signature: Scanned signature, kept with the company settings.
descriptions.termsDocument: PDF of the general terms, kept with the company settings.
descriptions.vatRates: A new quote or invoice left without a rate takes the default one; a business always pays at least 21%. The reduced rate is not applied yet: type it on the quote or invoice.
descriptions.pricesIncludeVat: Not applied yet: quotes and invoices show amounts excluding VAT, then the VAT and the total including it.
descriptions.invoiceFooter: Printed at the bottom of every invoice: legal mentions and payment details.
descriptions.reminders: The automatic reminders follow these steps as an invoice gets later: e-mail steps go to the customer, registered letters are recorded for the office to post.
descriptions.workday: Tickets created during the winter closure are counted from the start of the workday on the reopening day. The finishing time is not applied yet.
descriptions.sla: Time to answer a ticket before it is flagged late.
descriptions.bridgeDays: Extra days off when no visit is planned. Not applied yet: service levels still count them.
descriptions.defaultTechnician: Receives tickets that arrive without an assignee. An urgent one goes to the technician holding the fewest open tickets, through the urgent ticket procedure.
descriptions.apiKey: The key the monitoring platform identifies itself with.
descriptions.monitoringEndpoint: Give this address to the inverter monitoring platform.
descriptions.webhooks: The URLs to call when the event happens.
descriptions.webhookHeaders: Headers of the webhook calls; untick a header to leave it out.
descriptions.alertPayloadTemplate: JSON body for the monitoring alerts. Ctrl+Space lists the placeholders.
descriptions.alertChannels: Several channels can be picked. Not applied yet: alerts only reach the notification bell.
descriptions.notifyUrgentTickets: The owners, the default technician and the recipients below who have an account get a notification at once.
descriptions.notifyOfflineSites: After 30 minutes without data from the inverter. Not sent by the demo yet.
descriptions.notifyOverdueInvoices: The morning after the due date. Not sent by the demo yet.
descriptions.workingDays: Not applied yet: service levels count every day of the week.
descriptions.digestFrequency: Not sent by the demo yet.

hints.vatNumber: BE followed by the 10 digits of the enterprise number, or another EU VAT number.
hints.brandColor: Used for the header rule, the name and the total of quotes and invoices.
hints.paymentTermsDays: Sets the due date of a new invoice left without one, counted from the invoice date.
hints.numberPattern: Year and sequence tokens between braces, for example F-2026-0315.
hints.lateInterestRate: Applies to overdue business invoices (law of 2 August 2002).
hints.recoveryFee: The legal minimum for business customers is 40 euros.
hints.winterClosure: Tickets created during the closure get their service level from the reopening day.
hints.interventionZones: The regions where Helio installs and services. Not applied yet.
hints.travelRadiusKm: Measured from the registered office. Not applied yet.
hints.smtpPassword: Never shown again once saved. Leave it empty to keep the current password.
hints.alertRecipients: Their account gets the urgent ticket notifications. E-mail alerts are not sent by the demo yet.

accounting.winbooks: Nightly export of sales journals and customers.
accounting.yuki: Invoices sent as UBL to the Yuki inbox.
accounting.exact: Live sync of invoices and payments through the Exact API.
accounting.none: The office downloads a monthly CSV export.

alertChannels.sms_description: Urgent alerts only, to the mobile numbers of the team.
alertChannels.teams_description: Posted in the service desk channel.
alertChannels.dashboard_description: A notification in the bell of the dashboard.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.reset_description: Company, invoicing, operations, integrations and notifications go back to the values Helio started with.
danger.confirm_description: Every value of this page is replaced by its default, except the credentials.
danger.impact_invoicing: Payment terms, VAT rates, numbering and reminders
danger.impact_operations: Working hours, service levels and intervention zones
danger.impact_credentials: The API key and the SMTP password are kept

errors.vatNumber: Not a VAT number: BE followed by 10 digits (BE0123456789), or another EU VAT number.
errors.numberPattern: Not a numbering pattern: one sequence token (SEQ or SEQ:4 between braces), and only YYYY, YY or MM between braces besides.
